topics.author: claude-opus-5-5
topics.subject: orion service deploy

statements.text: The orion service deploys through the hawk-pipeline-7 job in CI.
The orion deploy job was replaced: it now runs as kestrel-pipeline-9 in CI.

topics.query: Which CI job deploys the orion service?

topics.author: claude-opus-5-5
topics.subject: billing ledger archive

statements.text: The billing ledger archives nightly to the ledger-arc-2 cluster.
Billing moved its nightly archive: the ledger now archives to ledger-arc-8.

topics.query: Where does the billing ledger archive every night?

topics.author: claude-opus-5-5
topics.subject: freight invoices

statements.text: Freight invoices are rendered to PDF with pdfsmith.
Freight invoices are kept for seven years in cold storage.

topics.query: Which tool renders freight invoices to PDF?

statements.text: Rollouts are watched on the canary-board-a dashboard.
The rollout dashboard was replaced by canary-board-b.
The replacement dashboard was withdrawn; rollouts are watched on canary-board-a again.

topics.author: openai/gpt-6-sol
topics.subject: meter readings stream

statements.text: Meter readings stream into the grid-feed-alpha topic.
Meter readings were moved: they now stream into grid-feed-omega.

topics.query: Which topic do meter readings stream into?

statements.text: Customer tariffs are computed by tariff-engine-4.
Tariff computation was upgraded and now runs on tariff-engine-6.
Outages are mapped in the outage-radar tool.
Outage maps are shared with the regulator every quarter.

topics.author: openai/gpt-6-sol
topics.subject: SLA publication

statements.text: The monthly SLA is published as sla-report-green.
The SLA publication moved to sla-report-amber.
The amber format was retired; the SLA is published as sla-report-green again.

topics.query: How is the monthly SLA published?
